title: OAuthIntegrationAssociationOutput
description: Represents an association between a content item and an OAuth integration.

app_guid.description: This field is deprecated and has been renamed to `content_guid`.

content_guid.description: The unique identifier of the content item.

oauth_integration_guid.description: The unique identifier of an existing OAuth integration.

oauth_integration_name.description: A descriptive name that identifies the OAuth integration.

oauth_integration_description.description: A brief text that describes the OAuth integration.

oauth_integration_template.description: The template used to configure this OAuth integration.

oauth_integration_auth_type.description:
Indicates which OAuth flow is used by this integration. The
"Viewer" authentication type corresponds to the Authorization Code
flow. The "Service Account" authentication type corresponds to the
Client Credentials flow.

created_time.description: The timestamp (RFC3339) indicating when this association was created.
